correctness.rationale: For each base core v, maximality forces exactly one of the core singleton or its entire leaf fiber into a maximal independent set. The independent core sets are therefore in a direct bijection with concepts. Two queries from one module cannot shatter; any queried adjacent core indices cannot simultaneously request core inclusion; conversely an independent queried projection realizes all labelings by selecting precisely the demanded cores. There are (t+1)^k supports per independent k-set, yielding the entire polynomial. Following the core-selected branch in a complete online query tree produces distinct independent core vertices and bounds Littlestone depth by alpha(G); core queries on a maximum independent set achieve it. For t=1 all MIS have |V(G)| vertices, and the established 2016 whiskering theorem supplies pure vertex-decomposability. Star facets of sizes 1 and m, induced flag-complex realization and explicit-input Independent Set hardness follow. Empty graph, isolated vertices, t=1, and all finite parameters included. The standalone checker independently exhausts 1188 labeled graph / t cases and 49190 shattered-support instances.

originality.rationale: The reviewed 2021 primary source studies independence complexes and topology without maximal-independent-set shattering; the 2016 whiskering source proves pure vertex-decomposability but not a shattering-support polynomial, online dimension, or universal induced flag-complex realization. A relevant 2016 source is disclosed as older supporting literature rather than assigned the 2021 primary-source date. The closest matching private prior statements cover forests and cographs, which are strict graph subfamilies and do not imply the all-base-graph result. The published-finding corpus hits address general-position sets of complete-graph coronas, topological independence complexes, and unrelated polynomial encodings. Strong priority risk: the argument is elementary and may be an unrecorded corollary of known whiskering descriptions; no uniqueness is asserted.

value.rationale: The theorem is not merely the VC dimension of a small graph: it transfers complete face structure and coefficient counts of every graph independence complex to a maximal-independent-set query class on a well-covered graph, realizes arbitrary flag complexes on the core of an arbitrarily well-behaved pure vertex-decomposable graph, gives equality of two learning dimensions, yields NP-completeness of represented promised-class VC dimension, and separates purity of the original graph independence complex from purity of the shattering complex with an unbounded example. These answer natural structural and complexity questions about maximal-independent-set membership classes; no downstream theorem is assumed.
